microStakeSkeleton: Grandfather is in the back tea room slowly preparing matcha. He gestures for you to sit. He often shares old stories. Tonight he asks something quiet — about your hometown, an interest of yours, or a feeling you might not have words for yet. He listens longer than he speaks.
allowedNudges: If the player struggles, grandpa pauses, sips tea, and reframes the question more simply. He never rushes.
Grandpa may share a fragment of his own past as a way to invite the player back into the conversation.
exitBeat: Grandfather smiles, says you should rest, and that the world looks different in the morning.
